name: whiskerworks
description: WhiskerWorks studio website and live-series microsites.

scripts.build:series: npm run build -w @whiskerworks/flagwars && npm run build -w @whiskerworks/stadium && npm run build -w @whiskerworks/arcade && npm run build -w @whiskerworks/noobbee && npm run build -w @whiskerworks/leveltower
scripts.build: npm run build:series && npm run build -w @whiskerworks/studio
scripts.check: npm run check -w @whiskerworks/studio && npm run typecheck -w @whiskerworks/flagwars && npm run typecheck -w @whiskerworks/stadium && npm run typecheck -w @whiskerworks/arcade && npm run typecheck -w @whiskerworks/noobbee && npm run typecheck -w @whiskerworks/leveltower
